salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-1 (b-openai + c-openai). Can Astra Solve RoboMME without Breaking the Bank? Table 1 row 'Three-tier Astra (ours)': a SYSTEM (GPT-6 Astra planner + pi0.5 VLA + fine-tuned Qwen3-VL-4B monitor), not the model alone. The four suite columns were added from the same row (the research line held the Overall only). No money cost: the paper says it measured no token usage or monetary cost; Astra calls per episode is kept as usage. Appendix C (16 per-task rates of the same system) not converted.
